Welcome. This site is my **public research journal** on machine unlearning.

I write here to think out loud: each post takes one idea, formalises it, tries to
break it, and records what remains unclear — so that it can be lifted more or
less directly into my thesis manuscript later. Whatever plan a post ends up with,
four things are meant to be there every time: the claim stated in a single
blockquote before any maths, an honest line between what is proved and what is
conjectured, a section of open questions, and a *Reproducing* section naming the
scripts that regenerate every number.

Two threads run through the posts and they cross more than once: one on
optimising against two objectives at once, one on what unlearning is and how it
should be measured. Posts that a later one amends carry a note at the top saying
so.

Nothing here is peer-reviewed. Expect half-formed ideas, dead ends, and the
occasional sign error. When a later post overturns an earlier one, the earlier
one gets a note at the top rather than a silent edit.
